question: Lactic acid is commonly found in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milk**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Lactic Acid__ is present in milk.

__
 
• It does have a CH3CH(OH)COOH molecular formula.
 
• It's strong white, and miscible with water.
 
• Because of the presence of a carboxyl group adjacent to the hydroxyl group, it is an alpha-hydroxy acid (AHA).
 
• It is produced by the fermentation of milk.​
